# uses scale

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usesScale`](gmeow-usesScale.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usesScale>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The score scale a rubric or criterion uses. Domain-free (rubric-level default, criterion-level override — the holder is whatever points here); functional: one scale per holder, the [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md) convention.

**Property shape:** object property; `?` -> [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md); functional

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the score scale a rubric (as default) or a criterion (as override) uses.

### Avoid when

- Avoid more than one scale per holder (it is functional, the [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md) convention) and avoid restating the rubric default on every criterion — set it once and override only where needed.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:usesScale`](gmeow-usesScale.md) once from the rubric or criterion to a [`gmeow:ScoreScale`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreScale.md); a criterion-level scale overrides the rubric default.
